programme.desc: S2:E13 Pingu et Pinga font du camping | Pinga a le hoquet | Tel père, tel Pingu - Pingu et Pinga dorment sous une tente et Pingu essaie de lui faire peur. | Pinga a le hoquet et Pingu essaie de le faire partir en l'effrayant. | Pingu accompagne papa à la pêche et découvre que papa ne sait pas tout.

programme.title: Pingu
programme.sub-title: S2:E14 Les sculptures de glace de Pingu | Le ballon de Pinga | Pingu et le groupe
programme.desc: S2:E14 Les sculptures de glace de Pingu | Le ballon de Pinga | Pingu et le groupe - Tout le monde participe au concours de glace, sauf Pingu. | Pingu et papa essaient de gonfler un ballon, mais c'est dur. | Pingu et Pinga rendent maman folle en utilisant tout comme tambour.

programme.title: Pingu
programme.sub-title: S2:E15 Pingu et la machine à tricoter | Les ombres du soir de Pingu | Pingu joue à chat
programme.desc: S2:E15 Pingu et la machine à tricoter | Les ombres du soir de Pingu | Pingu joue à chat - Pingu veut utiliser la machine à tricoter de maman. Quand elle se repose, il en profite pour tricoter à toute vitesse ! | C'est l'heure du coucher, mais Pingu et Pinga jouent encore dehors. | Pingu et Pinga jouent à chat. Pingu croit s'être échappé, mais il se retrouve coincé.

programme.title: Pingu
programme.sub-title: S2:E16 Pingu et les autocollants | Pingu et la sonnette | Le numéro d'équilibre de Pingu
programme.desc: S2:E16 Pingu et les autocollants | Pingu et la sonnette | Le numéro d'équilibre de Pingu - Pingu et Pinga trouvent des autocollants dans leur boîte de céréales et commencent à étiqueter des objets. | Pingu sait qu'il a des ennuis quand il casse la sonnette de l'igloo. | Robby est extrêmement doué pour faire tenir un poisson en équilibre sur le bout de son nez.

programme.title: Jembête Lewbert
programme.desc: Alors qu'une histoire d'amour est sur le point de naître entre Lewbert et Mme Benson, la bande décide de leur mettre des bâtons dans les roues.

programme.title: Cest pas de la tarte
programme.desc: Carly, Sam et Spencer emmènent Freddie dans leur boutique de tartes préférée. A leur arrivée, ils apprennent que le propriétaire a disparu en emportant la recette des tartes avec lui.

programme.title: Spencer est normal
programme.desc: Alors qu'il souhaite pimenter un peu la tradition de Noël avec un arbre peu conventionnel, Spencer met accidentellement le feu aux cadeaux de Carly. Bouleversée, elle rêve d'avoir un frère normal.

programme.title: Le premier baiser
programme.desc: Alors que Freddie confie à Carly qu'il n'a jamais embrassé une fille, Sam surprend leur conversation et dévoile le secret de Freddie sur Internet.

programme.title: Le concours
programme.desc: L'équipe organise un concours sur iCarly.com pour gagner une voiture.

programme.title: Meilleurs ennemis
programme.desc: Carly, Sam et Freddie vexent une starlette du web dénommée Fred. Ce dernier tente alors de convaincre ses abonnés vidéo de ne plus jamais regarder iCarly.

programme.title: Trop jeune pour ça
programme.desc: Carly, Sam et Freddie sont invités à assister à un combat d'arts martiaux pour filmer en coulisses. Mais Spencer et Mrs Benson refusent de les laisser y aller.

programme.title: Que le meilleur chante
programme.desc: Carly, Sam et Freddie demandent aux fans d'iCarly de voter pour David Archuleta afin qu'il remporte AMERICA SINGS. Mais ils se sentent mal à l'aise par rapport au deuxième et l'aident à créer son clip.

programme.title: Sam devient gentille
programme.desc: Sam craque sur un garçon qui n'aime que les filles très féminines. Carly aide alors Sam à se relooker.

programme.title: Carly et Clyde
programme.desc: Griffin, le nouveau voisin de Carly et Spencer, vole la moto que Carly a offert à Spencer.

programme.title: La meilleure amie
programme.desc: Missy Robinson, l'ancienne amie de Carly, revient dans sa vie. Sam se sent alors mise de côté.

programme.title: iCarly
programme.desc: Carly, Sam et Freddie perdent l'URL iCarly au profit de Nevel. Ce dernier demande à Carly de l'embrasser en échange de l'URL. De son côté, Spencer s'amuse avec les deux cent oreillers qu'il a commandés par erreur...

programme.title: Le combat
programme.desc: Carly et la championne d'arts martiaux Shelby Marx acceptent de se livrer à une démonstration de combat pour le compte d'une oeuvre de charité.

programme.title: Le combat
programme.desc: Carly et la championne d'arts martiaux Shelby Marx acceptent de se livrer à une démonstration de combat pour le compte d'une oeuvre de charité.

programme.title: iCarly
programme.desc: Carly, Sam et Freddie présentent les iCarly Awards. Ils récompensent en direct les auteurs des meilleurs contenus envoyés sur le site.

programme.title: Dummie la Mommie et le Sphinx de Shakaba
programme.desc: Bien décidée à devenir célèbre, Dummie la momie peut compter sur l'aide de son meilleur ami et de son père. Un jour, ceux-ci apprennent l'existence d'une petite statuette en or représentant un sphinx qui a le pouvoir de transformer Dummie en être humain.

programme.title: Blue, mon chien d'Australie
programme.desc: Une histoire australienne emblématique de la famille, de l'amitié et de l'aventure, entre un jeune garçon et un chien rustique unique en son genre qui deviendra une légende australienne.

programme.title: Halloween Island
programme.desc: Kai, Leilani et Eddie, trois enfants que tout oppose, doivent mettre de côté leurs différences pour sauver Hawaï d'un terrible démon légendaire qu'ils ont réveillé par erreur. Face aux plus grands dangers, les enfants vont comprendre ce que sont le courage, l'amitié et les traditions.

programme.title: Le Maître du jeu
programme.desc: La nouvelle passion du jeune Ivan Drago pour les jeux de société le propulse dans le monde fantastique et compétitif de l'invention de jeux, et l'oppose à l'inventeur Morodian, qui désire depuis longtemps détruire la ville de Zyl, fondée par le grand-père d'Ivan.

programme.title: Orc Wars
programme.desc: Une armée d'Orcs est envoyée dans notre monde pour l'envahir. Un ancien militaire est désigné malgré lui comme étant LE tueur d'Orcs et l'unique sauveur de l'humanité. L'affrontement ultime peut commencer…

programme.title: Mayhem
programme.desc: Un virus se propage dans un cabinet d'avocats le jour où le jeune Derek est piégé par un collègue et injustement licencié, transformant les collaborateurs en bêtes sanguinaires.

programme.title: Rendel : le Cycle de la vengeance
programme.desc: Le justicier masqué Rendel doit arrêter le nouveau chef impitoyable de l'organisation VALA, Christopher "Smiley" Cox, qui est sur le point de diffuser un vaccin NH25 nocif dans le monde entier.

programme.title: Gacy
programme.desc: John Wayne Gacy est un citoyen modèle. Il ne rate jamais une occasion d'organiser une fête pour ses amis ou de se déguiser en clown pour amuser les enfants. Mais derrière cette façade trop idéale se cache un monstre. Gacy a tué 30 personnes, dont la plupart sont enterrées autour de sa maison.

programme.title: Gallow Walkers
programme.desc: Après avoir renié Dieu, un cow-boy nommé Kaos, se voit infliger une malédiction qui ramène à la vie tous ceux qu'il a tués et qu'il tuera. Très vite, une armée de victimes menée par Kansa, revient du monde des morts et se lance à sa poursuite. Afin d'équilibrer le combat, Kaos engage un jeune guerrier, Fabulos, pour se battre à ses côtés.

programme.title: Tomiris
programme.desc: C'est l'histoire de la vie de la grande reine de la steppe: la légendaire Tomiris. Elle est destinée à devenir une guerrière habile, à survivre à la perte de ses proches et à unir les tribus Scythes et Saka sous son autorité.

programme.title: Le quatrième pouvoir
programme.desc: Paul Jensen, journaliste à Moscou, accepte une offre de Katja. Accusé de terrorisme, il se retrouve piégé dans un engrenage infernal.

programme.title: Sukiyaki Western Django
programme.desc: Deux clans s'affrontent : les Genjis, dirigés par Yoshitsune, et les Heike, menés par Kiyomori, pour un trésor caché dans un village montagnard. Un jour, un tueur solitaire et habile arrive en ville.

programme.title: Le projet Atticus
programme.desc: Fondé en 1976 par le Dr Henry West, l'Institut Atticus étudiait des capacités paranormales : parapsychologie, voyance... Des centaines de cas ont été étudiés, mais rien ne préparait l'équipe à Judith.

programme.title: Flirt
programme.desc: Quentin et son meilleur ami, Antoine, entrent en classe de troisième. Quentin a une copine. Chloé. Celle-ci ne laisse pas insensible Thomas, le petit caïd du collège. Le monde de l'enfance se fissure définitivement pour Quentin.

programme.title: De l'esprit d'équipe
programme.desc: Plongée documentaire au sein de “Pro Spectre”, l'entreprise de chasseurs de fantômes de Gilles et Joël.

programme.title: Taupes
programme.desc: Un groupe de gangsters est poursuivi après avoir dérobé un fabuleux trésor. Alors qu'ils s'enfoncent et s'égarent dans une mystérieuse forêt, ils deviennent peu à peu des figures légendaires...

programme.title: Mazeppa
programme.desc: Johan, un pianiste doué mais peu sûr de lui, s'apprête à passer un important concours musical. Submergé par le stress, il se réfugie dans les toilettes des filles où il fait la connaissance d'une jeune femme qui lui offre un tout autre destin.

programme.title: Elikia
programme.desc: Elikia, l'histoire d'un jeune homme accablé par son quotidien désastreux qui décide de se lancer dans la danse suite à sa rencontre avec Gabrielle.

programme.title: Levittown
programme.desc: Un jeune homme traverse le quartier résidentiel de Levittown, première banlieue américaine, animé par un monologue aux répliques familières. Non loin de là et alors que le soleil se couche, une jeune femme est confrontée à une menace invisible.

programme.title: Mon Oncle
programme.desc: Un jeune garçon passe ses vacances d'été chez sa grand-mère. Chaque matin marque le début d'une longue attente jusqu'au soir lorsque son oncle rentre du travail et lui raconte sa journée. Il faut dire que tonton n'a pas un métier comme les autres. Il est cascadeur pour la télé...

programme.title: Gangster backstage
programme.desc: A l'occasion d'un casting en Afrique du Sud, Teboho Edkins a demandé à des gangsters de mettre en scène leur propre image.

programme.title: La nuit des jours
programme.desc: Mariée à un cosmonaute alcoolique, grosse et poilue, Tzutza est une étoile qui se réveille chaque jour pour briller!

programme.title: Sur la route du paradis
programme.desc: Leila et ses deux enfants, Sarah et Bilal, ont quitté leur terre natale afin de s'installer en France. Sans papiers, et à la recherche de son mari réfugié en Angleterre, Leila, qui souhaite offrir à ses enfants une vie meilleure, tente de survivre et de les élever dans la clandestinité. Alors qu'elle retrouve enfin la trace de son époux et dispose de l'argent nécessaire, l'étau se resserre.

programme.title: La vie sans truc
programme.desc: Popolo, le plus grand magicien du monde ! Tu parles ! Il vient de paumer les jambes d'Amabilé, sa sublime assistante, dans le numéro de la femme coupée en deux ! Pour la consoler, il lui a promis de lui payer des vacances à la mer. C'est bien beau ! Mais maintenant qu'il est sans boulot, va falloir qu'il aille faire le guignol au Paul Emploie, comme tout le monde !

programme.title: Benidorm
programme.desc: Dans une station balnéaire vivent une jeune mère et sa fille. L'une vit la nuit, l'autre le jour. Elles ne se croisent jamais et le seul lien qui leur permet de maintenir un semblant de vie commune est un talkie-walkie.

programme.title: Cache-Cash
programme.desc: Jacques, 58 ans, a fait un AVC. À son réveil à l'hôpital, deux hommes se tiennent à son chevet. Ils prétendent être ses amis de longue date, avoir braqué un bar-tabac avec lui, et être là pour récupérer leur part du butin. Selon eux, Jacques est le seul à savoir où se trouve l'argent. Seulement, Jacques ne se souvient plus de rien. Jacques bluffe-t-il ? Ces deux hommes sont- ils vraiment ses amis ?

programme.title: Bad Gones
programme.desc: Matteo, neuf ans, rêve d'assister à un match de foot de son équipe fétiche : l'Olympique Lyonnais. Son père décide de l'emmener au stade de Gerland, mais le prix des places est au dessus de ses moyens. Le père ne peut pas acheter les billets. Comment va-t-il faire face à cette humiliation ?

programme.title: L'Amour du risque
programme.desc: Lila est coach love. Elle anime un séminaire sur l'amour et la séduction pour jeunes hommes en grande souffrance au Bois de Boulogne. Mais un jour, voilà qu'elle voit débarquer son ex.

programme.title: On ira à Neuilly Inch'Allah
programme.desc: C'est l'histoire d'une manifestation de jeunes travailleurs de Vélib', qui apprennent la lutte et tentent de s'organiser. C'est l'histoire d'une joute entre l'image et le son.

programme.title: Boobzilla change de pneus
programme.desc: Leyomi Bum Bum, ancienne championne de tuning, filme le tutoriel de son dernier projet: Boobzilla.

programme.title: Giggino ‘o bello
programme.desc: Un vieux criminel, Nonno, se cache dans une cave avec Giggino son petit-fils.

programme.title: L'étrange disparition de M. Walter Werner
programme.desc: Où est donc passé Walter ? Alban semble être le seul à s'interroger.

programme.title: Entre chien et loup
programme.desc: Sohrab, un jeune soldat enrôlé dans l'armée, se retrouve face à ses congénères lors d'une manifestation.

programme.title: Le grand jeu
programme.desc: Mathias et Alex ont rendez-vous à l'aube sur un petit parking en pleine campagne. Ils se connaissent bien mais tout semble les opposer. Pourtant, un secret les unit. Cette année encore, rien ne pourra les détourner de ce qu'ils sont venus accomplir. Que nous révèlera leur entreprise mystérieuse et fantasque ?

programme.title: Je suis l'ombre d'une flamme
programme.desc: Un couple préhistorique tente d'allumer un feu...

programme.title: Peine perdue
programme.desc: Une fin d'après-midi au bord d'une rivière, un concert près de l'eau. L'étrange Rodolphe remarque Alex, jeune homme timide qui n'a d'yeux que pour Julia, parisienne en vacances. Rodolphe entreprend de l'aider, à sa manière...

programme.title: Never Back Down
programme.desc: Une femme est kidnappée et forcée de participer à des combats souterrains d'élite et doit se frayer un chemin vers la liberté.

programme.title: TOMIRIS
programme.desc: Voici l'histoire de la grande reine des steppes, la légendaire Tomyris. Destinée à devenir une guerrière habile, elle devra survivre à la perte de ses proches et unir les tribus scythes/sakas sous son autorité.

programme.title: Killerman
programme.desc: Moe Diamond est un blanchisseur d'argent à New York qui se réveille sans aucun souvenir, avec des millions de dollars en espèces volées et de la drogue. Il doit rapidement parcourir les rues à la recherche de réponses tout en essayant d'échapper à une équipe de policiers violents et corrompus.

programme.title: The Sorcerer's Apprentice
programme.desc: Ben emménage dans une nouvelle maison. L'adolescent se lie d'amitié avec leur nouveau voisin, qui est en fait le célèbre magicien Merlin. Alors que ce dernier affronte la terrible fée Morgane, il enseigne à Ben les rudiments de la magie.

programme.title: The Midas Touch
programme.desc: Drame sur un garçon de 12 ans qui rêve d'avoir assez d'argent pour pouvoir soigner la grave maladie cardiaque de sa grand-mère. Lorsqu'il se retrouve dans une maison hantée, le mystérieux propriétaire lui « accorde » un vœu : la touche Midas. Le garçon apprend vite que c'est plus une malédiction qu'une bénédiction lorsque tout ce qu'il touche se transforme en or.

programme.title: Poisson D'avril
programme.desc: Emile, un mécanicien apprécié mais un brin naïf, se laisse convaincre par un vendeur insistant et lui achète un attirail de pêche. Préférant cacher cette dépense déraisonnable à sa femme, Emile s'éclipse pour tester le matériel chez une cousine, Annette. Une série de quiproquos improbables les obligent à prétendre que tous deux forment un couple.

programme.title: Trumbo
programme.desc: En 1947, Dalton Trumbo était le meilleur scénariste d'Hollywood, jusqu'à ce que lui-même et d'autres artistes soient emprisonnés et mis sur liste noire pour leurs convictions politiques.

programme.title: Lions et agneaux
programme.desc: Dans les montagnes enneigées d'Afghanistan, un hélicoptère de l'armée américaine est abattu par les talibans. Perdus en milieu hostile, les soldats sortis indemnes du crash luttent pour survivre en attendant d'éventuels renforts.

programme.title: La Panthère Rose
programme.desc: Un célèbre entraîneur de football est assassiné et sa bague, ornée du fameux diamant ‘'La Panthère Rose'' a disparu. L'inspecteur en chef Dreyfuss confie l'enquête à l'inspecteur Jacques Clouseau, le plus maladroit, le plus empoté, le plus incapable des agents de police.

programme.title: Le Sourire De Mona Lisa
programme.desc: Julia Roberts, lauréate d'un Oscar, brille dans ce film au casting étourdissant : Kirsten Dunst, Julia Stiles, Maggie Gyllenhaal et l'oscarisée Marcia Gay Harden.

programme.title: Sahara (2005)
programme.desc: Pour Dirk Pitt, explorateur, scientifique et aventurier, découvrir cette pièce de légende n'était que le premier pas vers l'aventure la plus risquée de sa vie et une incroyable légende historique...

programme.title: Grossesse en péril
programme.desc: Emily, enceinte, se lie d'amitié avec Kelly, mais cette dernière prévoit de lui voler son bébé.

programme.title: Un Marriage qui fait rêver
programme.desc: Une romantique célibataire fixe la date de son mariage, ignorant que le véritable amour est sous son nez.

programme.title: Marcher vers l'amour
programme.desc: Une conservatrice s'associe à un artiste d'avant-garde pour sauver son musée, et elle trouve l'amour.

programme.title: Les fantômes du passé
programme.desc: Amy est invitée à Seattle pour donner une conférence sur le roman policier et une mort suspecte survient.

programme.title: Méfiez-vous de la baby-sitter
programme.desc: Stella embauche Blake comme nounou, ignorant que c'est sa fille biologique venue pour détruire sa famille.

programme.title: Cube Zero
programme.desc: Une groupe de participants forcés se déplace frénétiquement à travers une construction sinistre de pièces cubiques. Chaque pièce contient la menace d'une mort affreusement inventive et douloureuse. Mais trouver la vraie sortie n'offrira peut-être pas la liberté recherchée.

programme.title: Remember Me
programme.desc: Au cours de l'été 2001, Tyler (Robert Pattinson), étudiant à New York, est encore bouleversé suite à la tragédie qui a altéré la relation avec son père lorsqu'il rencontre Ally (Emilie de Ravin), une fille qui comprend sa douleur. C'est une histoire inoubliable sur le pouvoir de l'amour, la force de la famille et l'importance de chérir ceux qu'on aime chaque jour de sa vie.

programme.title: Miss Potter
programme.desc: Une biographie de l'auteur de livres pour enfants Beatrix Potter racontant comment elle a affronté une mère autoritaire et le chauvinisme de l'Angleterre victorienne pour devenir l'auteur de best-sellers.

programme.title: Letters to Juliet
programme.desc: En vacances à Vérone, Sophie tombe sur une 'lettre à Juliette' et se lance dans une mission pour retrouver son auteur.

programme.title: Below the Beltway
programme.desc: Un film sur les coulisses du monde politique de Washington. Un ancien membre du personnel tombé en disgrâce tente de revenir dans le jeu politique...

programme.title: Big Mamma
programme.desc: Malcolm Turner, du FBI, est chargé de surveiller Sherry, l'ex d'un truand en cavale. Son rôle de composition (il se fait passer pour une grand-mère) va lui réserver des surprises.

programme.title: Ghost Town
programme.desc: La Ville fantôme est une comédie romantique pleine d'esprit(s) qui raconte l'histoire de Bertram Pincus, un dentiste irritable de Manhattan qui développe la capacité malencontreuse de voir les morts.

programme.title: I Love You, Man
programme.desc: Un jeune fiancé se met à la recherche du témoin parfait pour son mariage.

programme.title: Un Hologramme pour le Roi
programme.desc: Un homme d'affaires accepte un job en Arabie saoudite pour vendre une technologie à un puissant monarque.

programme.title: Le merveilleux jardin secret de Bella Brown
programme.desc: Bella, jeune femme fantasque, risque l'expulsion si elle ne remet pas son jardin en état. Elle fait alors la rencontre d'Alfie, son voisin bougon et passionné de jardinage, qui va bouleverser sa vie.

programme.title: Amour Aveugle

programme.title: Emma Grede On Why You Can't Be A People Pleaser And A Leader
programme.desc: Entrepreneur Emma Grede, co-founder of Good American, discusses why women need to talk openly about money and know their worth. She explains why ambition isn't a dirty word, why you can't be a people pleaser and a leader, and why getting comfortable with failure and self-doubt is essential. As a mother of four, Emma shares her thoughts on mum guilt and why it's important that children see their mothers chasing their goals.

programme.title: Lucas Jones Explores What We're All Searching For In Life
programme.desc: Poet and actor Lucas Jones joins Fearne Cotton to explore what we're all searching for in life—whether we call it God, the Universe, spirituality, or science. They bond over their inability to do small talk, preferring deeper conversations about big feelings, and both share their experiences of living with OCD. Lucas discusses how therapy, particularly CBT, has helped him, but questions whether the rise in therapy reflects a loss of real community.

programme.title: Bryony Gordon On How People Pleasing Fuelled My OCD
programme.desc: Author and mental health advocate Bryony Gordon explores how people pleasing has fuelled parts of her OCD, alcoholism, and eating disorders over the years. Fearne and Bryony discuss the 'fawn' trauma response - appeasing others to stay safe - and chat about body image and the insecurities that have consumed them. Bryony reckons feeling 'too much' and 'not enough' are two sides of the same coin, and offers advice on how to confidently take up space.

programme.title: Boy George on AI, Spirituality & Why Jealousy Is Pointless
programme.desc: Boy George joins Fearne to discuss ego, jealousy, fame, grief and the mindset shift that changed everything. From embracing the Three Principles to tapping every morning, he explains how learning to pause before reacting helped him let go of resentment and feel lighter than ever. He opens up about loving fame and why he'd do it differently if he could start again, AI, and why "hating someone is completely pointless".

programme.title: Philippa Perry On Why Everyone Has an Inner Critic
programme.desc: Psychotherapist and author Philippa Perry discusses why everyone has an inner critic and how to stop believing yours. Philippa explains why not feeling 'good enough' is often less about truth and more about habit. She shares how to tell the difference between a helpful critical inner voice and a self-sabotaging one, and why negative thought patterns keep us stuck.

programme.title: Sam Thompson On His Anxiety And Undiagnosed ADHD
programme.desc: Sam Thompson discusses how anxiety and undiagnosed ADHD have shaped his relationships and self-confidence. He shares his experience of panic attacks, including one on the first day of I'm A Celebrity, and talks about therapy, the patterns he kept repeating, and his three go-to people during crises. Sam and Fearne debate people-pleaser approaches to leaving parties and discuss behind-the-scenes stories from his content creation work. Sam also reveals why he was willing to pay to appear on I'm A Celebrity.

programme.title: Sam Claflin Asks What Is Body Dysmorphia?
programme.desc: Actor Sam Claflin discusses his lifelong struggle with body dysmorphia and body image with Fearne Cotton. Sam explains what having body dysmorphia means to him and how it affects everything from the food he eats to his willingness to watch his own films back. Fearne and Sam discuss being chronic people pleasers and how they're working to stop putting everyone else's comfort before their own. Sam reflects on how he was brought up to think about masculinity and what he's doing to ensure his own son grows up with gentler male role models. They also reminisce about the early days of MSN and webcam chatrooms.

programme.title: On The Ground At Tommy Robinson's Unite The Kingdom rally
programme.desc: Around 60,000 people gathered at Parliament Square on 16 May for Tommy Robinson's Unite The Kingdom rally, ostensibly to defend freedom, protect children, and take the country back. It was the smaller of two protests in central London, with at least a quarter of a million attending a pro-Palestine rally commemorating the 78th anniversary of the Nakba and uniting against the far-right. On the rally's main stage, a man covered in bacon played the cello.

programme.title: AI CEOs Being Absolutely Insane
programme.desc: Have you ever paid attention to the voices behind the 'inevitable' AI revolution? OpenAI's Sam Altman, SpaceX's Elon Musk, and Palantir's Alex Karp are among the tech elite. They're building the models they claim will change work, politics, and life forever. But when they talk about this future, their rhetoric ranges from bizarre to sinister. From Musk's prediction that there's "a 10 to 20% chance of killer robots wiping out humanity" to Altman's sale of intelligence as utility, things look pretty bleak.

programme.title: Glen Powell Takes The Irish Test
programme.desc: Glen Powell and Edgar Wright are put to the test to see if they can earn themselves an honourary Irish passport. To do so, they must pass a series of tests to prove their Irishness. Do they know what a spicebag is? Can they tell the difference between real and fake Irish sayings? And can they identify some iconic Irish people?

programme.title: Taylor Lorenz Interview
programme.desc: Taylor Lorenz is the journalist mapping out the culture of the internet and everything surrounding it. She discusses the growing power of the right in the online world, their ever-tightening grip on regulations of the internet and speech in the digital space, and how to fight back against it.

programme.title: Why Politics Doesn't Work Anymore
programme.desc: Author and Academic Anton Jäger discusses his book Hyperpolitics, examining contemporary political participation and the challenges facing progressive movements. He explores the decline of traditional party politics, the shift towards hyperpolitics where people are engaged but unorganised, and why the right has been more successful in building institutions. Jäger outlines issues with social media activism and presents approaches to creating a more collectivised political movement capable of challenging right-wing advances.

programme.title: Palantir: The UK Government's Single Point Of Failure
programme.desc: Martin Wrigley is one of the few MPs who understands the threat of big tech. Earlier this year told us about the growing influence of AI firm Palantir across the British state, from the NHS and the Ministry of Defence to the Cabinet Office. Starting with an off-the-books meeting between Boris Johnson, Dominic Cummings, and Palantir co-founder Peter Thiel, Wrigley argues that the US tech giant has steadily embedded itself at the heart of government while remaining largely unscrutinised. Wrigley questions whether parliament even understands what Palantir's systems are doing. From data collection and technical lock-in to lobbying and corporate influence, he asks whether Britain's increasing dependence on a single American company might leave the country vulnerable.

programme.title: Alex Horne vs FootballJOE Quiz
programme.desc: Taskmaster and comedy legend Alex Horne takes on a quiz testing his knowledge of comedians, football, hams, chickens and more, filmed at the Chesham United clubhouse. Alex is promoting his annual Comedy Football Trophy match taking place at Chesham United, featuring some of the biggest names in comedy playing for a great cause.

programme.title: Kneecap Interview
programme.desc: Kneecap joined PoliticsJOE following the dismissal of their terror case against member Mo Chara in the British courts. The band discussed the legal proceedings, which centred on allegations that Chara displayed a Hezbollah flag during a London concert in November 2024. UK prosecutors had argued this could constitute an offence under the Terrorism Act, but the case was thrown out due to procedural failures.

programme.title: Gary Stevenson Interview
programme.desc: Gary Stevenson, economist and ex-Citibank trader, returns to PoliticsJOE just days after Andy Burnham became Prime Minister. Stevenson explains why he expects Labour to dodge serious taxation of the ultra-wealthy, instead quietly shifting the burden onto the upper middle class through moves like equalising capital gains and income tax. He breaks down why cutting VAT on energy bills is a quick political win rather than a real fix, and why he believes every government that fails to tax extreme wealth eventually gets forced into austerity, creating fertile ground for Reform and Farage.

programme.title: Ne-Yo Rates British Food, Tea, & Slang
programme.desc: Ne-Yo takes on The British Test, from making the perfect British cup of tea to trying Scampi Fries for the first time. The R&B superstar is thrown headfirst into UK culture, talks about what it means to perform in the UK, reveals why he'd love to be the 'Black Ed Sheeran', discusses what it's like to work with Pitbull, admits his crush on Leona Lewis, gives his thoughts on UK style, and hilariously trolls Jake Paul along the way.

programme.title: The Wayans Brothers & Anna Faris Quizzed!
programme.desc: Shawn Wayans, Marlon Wayans and Anna Faris go head-to-head in the JOE Pub Quiz. The comedy legends put their memories to the test in a rapid-fire quiz covering their biggest films, iconic roles, and career moments from Scary Movie and White Chicks to The House Bunny, Norbit, Just Friends, The Dictator and more.

programme.title: Norman Finkelstein Interview
programme.desc: Norman Finkelstein, foremost scholar on the politics of Palestine and Israel, discusses the deepening crisis in free speech stemming from public opposition to Western complicity in the Gaza conflict. He breaks down a lifetime of work on the Israel-Palestine conflict, explains shifts in the American and global right, and details underlying antisemitism in society and how it is deepened by crackdowns on freedom of expression.

programme.title: The Ageist and The Snob
programme.desc: Third generation matchmaker Patti Stanger is back and better than ever! She's taken over the exclusive Luxe Hotel in Bel-Air where she brings her toughest clients for a week-long lesson in love. This week, Patti is on the case with two tough lawyers: the ageist, David Goldman, and the first-class snob, Rhonda Wills. Right out of the gate, David jumps head first into a love lesson that he fails miserably when he ditches his age-appropriate date for a romp in the pool with a bunch of 20-somethings. Meanwhile, Patti struggles to convince Snobby Pants Rhonda to give up on her fairytale fantasy of Prince Charming. Patti, Candace, and Maxwell team up to find the perfect sexy singles for the mingle, but Patti throws the ageist David another curve ball when she adds a 22-year-old to the mix to test him. Will he fall for it and break Patti's rules or has he learned his lesson? Rhonda, on the other hand, meets a knight in shining armor. But… will she try to escape when he fails to deliver a fairytale first date. In the end, Patti's got a tough week. Will the lawyers learn their lesson or will it be a hung jury?

programme.title: Little Lovebird & Mr. Know-It-All
programme.desc: This season, Patti Stanger faces the toughest of the tough cases and this week is no exception. Jersey native, Jason Karniol is a poker playing ticket broker who thinks he knows everything. He takes his poker skills into his dating life and actually reads women's “tells”, dismissing them immediately. He performs true-to-type during his love lesson and infuriates Patti by insisting his methods work. Yelling and insults start flying and Patti lays down the law. Jason must stop his ridiculous “Forget-About-It Frank” behavior and get to know women before judging them. But old habits die hard and Jason struggles to follow Patti's rules. Meanwhile, little person Kacy McInturff from “Little Weddings” fame has only known bootie call love her entire adult life. And no one has ever told her they love her… ever! At 39, she feels the clock is ticking and wedding planner, Kacy needs to decide if she'll follow Patti demands, no matter how painful, in order to change the course of her life. Kacy needs to learn how to demand monogamy in her relationship. But this little lovebird has a habit of returning to her old familiar nest regardless of how much she wants things to change. Even the world's best matchmaker might not be able to break these two of their bad habits and help them find true love.

programme.title: Phantom of the Opera Bride
programme.desc: David Tutera has a special gift that turns any bride's concept into an unforgettable, dramatic event. And when he meets bride Amber Fleener, who wants the ultimate “Phantom of the Opera” wedding, David knows he's the right man for the job. But instead of romance and drama, David finds that while Amber is hoping for a grand production of Phantom, what's she come up with is more like a high school play. With cheap costume masks and fake flowers that look like Christmas decorations, and a venue that's more suited for a block party, Amber is in dire need of David's help. Before she knows it, David is revising everything, giving her a stunning and dramatic new bridal gown, putting her bridesmaids in romantic, classic dresses, and changing the venue to one suitable for the huge production she's hoping for. David even gives Amber an unforgettable rehearsal dinner with family and friends before the big night!

programme.title: Alice in Wonderland Bride
programme.desc: Bride Chrissy Pumphrey-Duran and fiancé Jason Smith share a love for literature, so when it came time to decide on a theme for their wedding, they thought that Lewis Carroll's classic tale “Alice in Wonderland” would be perfect. But when David Tutera meets with the bride to see what she's come up with, he finds that Chrissy has gone way too far! From the black and white striped socks, she plans to wear under her black bridal gown to the chin-strapped top hats she's putting on her bridesmaids, this wedding needs a major rewrite! With only three weeks before the wedding, David rushes into action, changing Chrissy's dreary, gothic bridal gown to an elegant and dramatic gown worthy of her classic theme, gives the bridesmaids much needed color in their dresses, and moving the venue from a local club to a Hollywood soundstage. David even gives his bride a once-in-a-lifetime experience: a magical tea party with her as the guest of honor!

programme.desc: Feeling that Jeannie must widen her horizons, Tony gives her a book "How To Be A Woman." Following the book's advice, to share her work with her man, Jeannie neglects her chores and allows the house to go to pot. Her employer, Sam, feeling she has been planted to get him into trouble with the Better Business Bureau, fires her. Later, after Tony feels he has straightened out things at home, Jeannie hears a news report about the flight of a Russian female astronaut. Blinking her eyes, she is outfitted as an astronaut and insists on accompanying Tony into space.

programme.title: Bewitched (Colorized) S1E36
programme.desc: Almost as determined as Endora to break up Samantha's marriage to a mere mortal, Samantha's cousin Edgar, an elf, begins playing pranks on Darrin. Darrin's agency has been trying to hold onto the Shelley Shoe account. Edgar, invisible to all, plagues Darrin in his office. Darrin is sure Endora is working on him again, and has difficulty persuading Larry Tate to let him present the new campaign to Mr. Shelley. At the sales meeting, Fred Schulwiler, as unscrupulous competitor, almost gets the account when he makes it appear that Darrin is trying to make Mr. Shelley look ridiculous. When Samantha convinces Edgar that she is very happy with Darrin, he switches his attentions to Schulwiler. Before Edgar is through, Schulwiler has lost all chance of landing the Shelley account. Darrin, coming up with an advertising campaign featuring an elf not unlike Edgar, ties up the account for his firm.

programme.title: Bewitched (Colorized) S2E37
programme.desc: Samantha's Aunt Clara arrives on the Stephens' first anniversary with presents for Samantha and Darrin. Casting a spell to adjust a checkered cap she has given Darrin, Aunt Clara uses the wrong words and turns Darrin into a chimpanzee. Unable to remember how to remove the spell, Aunt Clara goes home to look for the formula. When Samantha leaves the house, Endora stays with Darrin. Darrin leaps out of a window and runs into Gladys Kravitz. She takes the chimp back to her house. Soon after, Aunt Clara comes with her book of magic, Samantha returns. Samantha tells Aunt Clara she must find Darrin since her doctor has told her she is going to have a baby. Meanwhile, Gladys and Abner have turned Darrin over to the zoo, where he is caged with three other chimps. Samantha goes to the zoo. Then Aunt Clam arrives and turns Darrin back to his former self. Samantha is finally able to tell him he is to be a father. Later, Gladys begins telling the Stephens about the chimpanzee. Suddenly realizing that Darrin is wearing the same outfit as the chimp, Gladys streaks back to her own house.

programme.title: Bewitched (Colorized) S2E38
programme.desc: Learning that he is about to become a father, Darrin waits on Samantha hand and foot. Then Larry Tate convinces him that all women would make a career out of having a baby if you allowed them to. He gives Darrin a book on the subject which states that the more active the mother, the happier she will be, and the healthier the child. Darrin returns home completely convinced. Endora is infuriated when she hears Darrin ordering Samantha to do chores around the house. The following day, Darrin wakes up with a backache. At an office lunch, he fights for extra pickles. When Samantha learns of this, she faces up to her mother. Endora admits she has cast a spell over Darrin, but will do nothing to change the situation for the present. Darrin, dis-cussing his plight at a bar, becomes obsessed with the idea that he is going to have a baby himself. Finally, Endora removes the spell and Darrin becomes completely attentive to Samantha once more. She agrees with Darrin's assertion that he is one man in a million who knows just how she feels.

programme.title: Bewitched (Colorized) S2E39
programme.sub-title: We'Re In For A Bad Spell
programme.desc: When strange things begin happening to Adam Newlarkin, a friend of Darrin's, Aunt Clara tells Samantha he has inherited the spell placed by a witch on his ancestor who was a judge in Salem two hundred years before. Aunt Clara adds that unless Adam follows the antidote for the spell strictly, he will be branded a thief. The Stephens learn that Adam has been hired by a local bank. Samantha and Darrin manage to get Adam to kiss a dog, the first step. With Aunt Clara's help, Darrin dunks Adam in a pool three times. They have trouble persuading him to ride through town shouting praise of witches, which is the final step. However, finding his briefcase stuffed with money , Adam, a true native of Salem, believes he is under a spell. He mounts a horse and starts riding. Bank manager Abercrombie and a detective, having discovered the loss of seventy five thousand dollars, come to the Stephens' home. Aunt Clara makes the money disappear from the briefcase. Abercrombie apologizes to Adam after learning that a bank employee has been taken into custody with the stolen cash.

programme.title: The Power of Plants The Great Escape
programme.desc: You think plants are boring or passive? Far from it! They use complex reactions to respond to light, sound and touch. And like in the animal kingdom, different species have developed a near unending list of strategies to ensure their legacy is passed on. Plants have evolved tricks to beat the ele-ments, animal enemies or even other plants: From thorns and spines to poisons and even live-in bodyguards. This two-part series shows the survival strategies of our green “roommates” we share the planet with.

programme.title: The Power of Plants Race to Grow and Breed
programme.desc: Just like animals, the lives of plants are dominated by the need to become strong and pass on genes to the next generation – a race to grow and breed. They must race to beat their competition to the best light spots, and to make the most of perilously short seasons. And also like in the animal kingdom, different species have developed a near unending list of strategies to ensure their legacy is passed on. Our ideas about plants need a seed change – it's time to respect the power of plants.

programme.title: Hidden Japan
programme.desc: Japan is the fourth largest island nation in the world and the second most populous. The culture of Japan is incredible, but even this is overshadowed by nature's beauty. There are more than 130 mammals and an astonishing 600 bird species dwelling in Japan's 6,852 islands. This island chain is so long that it spans several climate zones, providing a huge range of habitat for wildlife. Look beyond the ancient temples and glass skyscrapers and volcanos loom, bears hunt and birds do battle. This is the hidden Japan.

programme.title: Eyes Of The Atacama
programme.desc: ALMA – the Atacama Large Millimeter Array – is the ultimate space observation facility. Here, 66 leviathan parabolic antennae trap cosmic rays in the previously unobservable long-wave range. It can only happen in Atacama, far away from civilisation's pollution of the night sky with artificial light.

programme.title: North America's National Parks
programme.desc: Saguaro National Park is an American national park in Pima County, southeastern Arizona. The 92,000-acre (37,000 ha) park consists of two separate areas—the Tucson Mountain District (TMD) about 10 miles west of the city of Tucson and the Rincon Mountain District (RMD) about 10 miles east of the city—that preserve Sonoran Desert landscapes, fauna, and flora, including the giant saguaro cactus.An inventory of medium and large mammals in the park confirmed the presence of 30 species in Saguaro National Park between 1999 and 2008. Of these, 21 were found in the Tucson Mountain District and 29 in the Rincon Mountain District. A partial list of the park's mammals includes cougars, coyotes, bobcats, white-tailed deer, mule deer, javelinas, gray foxes, black-tailed jackrabbits, desert cottontails, ring-tailed cats, white-nosed coatis, ground squirrels, and packrats. One endangered mammal, the lesser long-nosed bat, lives part of the year in the park and part of the year in Mexico.

programme.title: North America's National Parks
programme.desc: Great Smoky Mountains National Park is an American national park in the southeastern United States, with parts in Tennessee and North Carolina. The park straddles the ridgeline of the Great Smoky Mountains, part of the Blue Ridge Mountains, which are a division of the larger Appalachian Mountain chain. The park contains some of the highest mountains in eastern North America, including Clingmans Dome, Mount Guyot, and Mount Le Conte. The border between the two states runs northeast to southwest through the center of the park. The Appalachian Trail passes through the center of the park on its route from Georgia to Maine. With 12.5 million visitors in 2019, the Great Smoky Mountains National Park is the most visited national park in the United States.

programme.title: North America's National Parks
programme.desc: Yellowstone National Park is an American national park located in the western United States, largely in the northwest corner of Wyoming and extending into Montana, and Idaho. It was established by the U.S. Congress and signed into law by President Ulysses S. Grant on March 1, 1872. Yellowstone was the first national park in the U.S. and is also widely held to be the first national park in the world. The park is known for its wildlife and its many geothermal features, especially Old Faithful geyser, one of its most popular. While it represents many types of biomes, the subalpine forest is the most abundant. It is part of the South Central Rockies forests ecoregion.

programme.title: The Seychelles
programme.desc: The 115 islands and islets that make up the Seychelles present a breath-taking variety of plants, rare animals and beaches laced with palms. This is where the leg-endary Coco de Mer palm nuts grow with fruits weigh-ing up to 20 kilos and giant wild land turtles nibble away at mangrove fruits to their hearts content. The archipelago was first settled at the end of the 18th cen-tury. Today, a very colourful potpourri of peoples in this dwarf state proves just how peacefully different cultures can live side by side. Three times a week, the steamer "MV Espoir" completes the trip from the main island of Mahé to Praslin and back. A ship for every-one and practically everything: Used cars, toilet paper, horses, bicycles, furniture - you name it, the Espoir transports goods of all kinds. Coconuts sometimes pose a problem as there are far too many of them. What to do with them? The best place to send them is undoubt-edly Hubert Roumien's Virgin Coconut Oil Laboratory, hidden away in the Mahé jungle. Straw turns into gold at Seaweed Seychelles! There, Benjamin Port Louis collects seaweed and extracts liquid fertiliser from it.

programme.title: Enkrypted
programme.desc: The secret, he says, is the venom of a Tiger Widow, a rare creature that lives on only one island. The venom can slow a djinn down. Soto is the only one who knows where the island is and will only tell if the ninja break him out of jail. Meanwhile, Nadakhan has decided to return to his home realm of Djinjago, only to discover it is falling apart. The ninja's destruction of the Cursed Realm is affecting the realms connected to it. Nadakhan uses the Djinn Blade to smash the Teapot, absorbing all the spirits that were trapped there into the sword. Nadakhan vows revenge on the ninja and NINJAGO. The ninja and Soto escape from jail, only to find out the map to the island is on Nadakhan's ship. Nadakhan discovers that Nya looks just like Delara, his long-lost love.Falsely imprisoned, the Ninja are at their lowest point, but find an unlikely friend in an old enemy. Meanwhile, Nadakhan rescues his marooned crew and gains a new perspective, along with a new mysterious plan. With the ninja imprisoned, Nadakhan uses the Realm Crystal to free his old crew. The ninja encounter Captain Soto, the first captain of the Destiny's Bounty, who tells them the story of how he originally trapped Nadakhan in the Teapot.

programme.title: Misfortune Rising
programme.desc: The ninja's search for Nadakhan's ship turns up nothing. Nadakhan's crew is struggling to handle an airship which used to sail only on the oceans. Nadakhan confronts Jay and talks him into making a wish that will win him Nya. Jay wishes that he wasn't born in a junkyard and was rich. The next moment, he receives a letter saying his father has died and he has inherited his estate. Jay rushes home to find his parents in the junkyard and finds out they are fine, but they reveal that he is adopted. Jay discovers that his real father is the actor who played his favorite movie hero. In an effort to trap the ninja, the Sky Pirates start raids all over NINJAGO City. Nadakhan kidnaps Kai, who makes two wishes, both of which go wrong. His third wish is to “make it all go away.” Nadakhan's first mate, Flintlocke, accidentally destroys the Realm Crystal and Cole steals Soto's map. The Destiny's Bounty mysteriously vanishes from the police impound yard.The Ninja are on a collision course to find the map to stop Nadakhan, they first must find him. Meanwhile, Jay makes a wish to change his future, but it could alter his past indefinitely.

programme.title: The Cloud
programme.desc: A storm is brewing over Knighton. Monstrox has taken the form of a cloud, and is raising an army of lightning infused Stone Monsters. His first target is the new Lavalands Amusement Park. Harmony reigns in Knighton as the Knights pursue their civilian lives: Lance has a TV talk show Axl is the singing chef on the show Jestro is the weatherman Clay is teaching at the Knights' Academy Macy, Ava and Merlok 2.0 travel the land in the Fortrex making sure the kingdom's defenses are ready (part of a plan she and Clay have) Aaron and his hover shield is travelling the land setting extreme records. Robin is at his workshop at the Knights' Academy doing an “independent study” – he's working on some top secret project for Merlok 2.0. It all seems excellent! We even see the Knights new vehicles – which have been optimized for civilian life (except for Clay's.) But storm clouds are brewing. Well, one storm cloud is brewing: the Cloud of Monstrox! Yes, the Book of Monsters has reconstituted himself and is now a cloud who needs a man on the ground to enact his new evil plan. He follows his old buddy Jestro as he goes across the realm on the weekends apologizing for being evil. ZAP! With one bolt of his evil magic lighting, the Cloud of Monstrox turns Jestro evil again (only this time a bit, well, too evil.) The evil duo are back together – and bring stone to life for the first time in the form of Gargoyles from the town of GHOULIA. Now they must gather the Forbidden Powers so that the Cloud of Monstrox can destroy the entire kingdom! A battle breaks out in the Lava Lands, where Lance and Alice Squires are reporting from the opening of the Cuthbert Richmond funded Lava Lands Amusement Park, rebuilt from the remains of Jestro's old HQ. Jestro and the Cloud are after something in the remains and as Merlok 2.0 sends out a call for the Knights to help Lance. Can Lance (with an assist from King Halbert in his Mech) hold-off Jestro, the Cloud and their new army of stone fighters?!

programme.title: A Little Rusty
programme.desc: The Cloud of Monstrox and Jestro unlocks a mysterious Forbidden Power. What kind ofhavoc will they unleash? And can Merlok 2.0 and the NEXO KNIGHTS make the new COMBO NEXO Powers work? The Knights finally make it to the Lava Lands – using their various new forms of transport, which are all strictly civilian vechicles – and they must regroup and learn to fight together again to face the new threat of Jestro, the Cloud of Monstrox, and their STONE MONSTERS (in this case, Stone Gargoyles.) But Jestro and his monsters beat back the knights and recover the STAFF OF MONSTROX – which was buried under the ceremonial chamber from Episode 210 (and is now the Lava Puker amusement park ride) – and they get away on Jestro's EVIL MOBILE, which he recovers from the HQ garage. Macy says this is exactly why she's been touring the kingdom preparing everyone for the next attack. The Knights have to get it together because now the entire kingdom is under threat…again. Robin decides he must upgrade the Knights' vehicles and make them more “fight optimized.” Ava and Merlok 2.0 must figure out how to use new NEXO Powers because regular NEXO Powers do make Stone monsters back into stone, but the Cloud simply zaps them to life again. Meanwhile, in the IRON MOUNTAINS, Jestro and the Cloud of Monstrox find the first of the Forbidden Powers: RELENTLESS RUST. They find the ROGUL STATUE holding the power and zap him to life. Now…they can rust those shiny knights to pieces! Ava and Merlok are attempting to use NEXO COMBO POWERS – with hilarious results – as they try to figure out how they might work. When Jestro attacks, he's able to halt the Fortrex by instantly rusting its tracks and wheels! Robin has his hands full trying to clean all the rust from the attack of Relentless Rust. As the Knights attempt to defend against Jestro, the Cloud is zapping statues to life. He hits a statue with a bolt of lightning as Clay is touching it. Something happens…Clay feels odd stiff as if rock is mixing with his body. Finally, Ava and Merlok 2.0 download to the Knights their new thing: a COMBO NEXO COMBO Power. It works! It can smash the animated statues to dust! They use it to defeat Jestro, but he and the Cloud get away with the Forbidden Power of Relentless Rust. Victory … sort of. Clay talks to Merlok 2.0…something has happened to him. What can they do? Merlok 2.0 is very concerned.

programme.title: Thunderstox
programme.desc: Jestro and the Cloud of Monstrox encounters the sculptor. He helps unleash a horde of fierce garden gnomes on Knighton. What will the NEXO KNIGHTS do against this new enemy? Will their new COMBO NEXO Powers do the trick? As Jestro and the Cloud of Monstrox head off on the Evil Mobile to 'store' the Forbidden Power in a secret location, they encounter…THE SCULPTOR. His real name is ROBERTO ARNOLDI. He's a sensitive and odd artist who has been laid off by the king (the King ordered a "smashing" statue of the Queen, and the Sculptor made a statue of the Queen literally smashing monsters. He takes everything very literally.) Jestro instructs him to make a "bad" statue that he can use to attack the knights. The Sculptor sets to work. Meanwhile, the NEXO KNIGHTS are discussing the COMBO NEXO Powers, the Forbidden Powers, and what all this means. Lance, meanwhile, decides that since his talk show career is on hold, he thinks he'll install cameras in the Fortrex and do a Big Brother-like expose show on the Knights (he decides NOT to tell the others.) Merlok 2.0 and the Cloud of Monstrox (each talking to their cohorts) explain the history of the Forbidden Powers: it's a history lesson about the WIZARDS' COUNCIL, the Forbidden Powers, and how they were stopped long ago. This visual montage leads Jestro to…MOUNT THUNDERSTROX. The Cloud of Monstrox shows him the circle of ten Standing Stones where he will insert the Forbidden Powers. "What'll happen after that?” asks Jestro, curious. "Oh, I don't want to spoil the surprise," says the Cloud. They insert the first Forbidden Power, Relentless Rust, and it locks into place on its stone. They go off to battle the Knights and collect the "bad" statue the sculptor is making. But he's made a literally bad statue…it's terrible ... garden gnomes. Like an amateur art student. And…it's not even finished. ("You can't rush bad genius!") The Knights attack with their newly modified vehicles and they succeed in destroying the Evil Mobile. They then try to use a COMBO NEXO Power, but can't…it had to be perfect to work (Ava and Merlok need to work on it.) As Jestro and the Cloud retreat, Merlok again talks to Clay about turning to stone! Merlok calls in Robin…he will need him to build something to help Clay as he becomes more and more impaired.

programme.title: Weekend At Halberts
programme.desc: Party time in Knighton! The mood is down so the King decides to throw a party. In the meantime Jestro attacks the Fortrex, but he is confronted with the new NEXO Power "The Wedgie of Doom". Clay is turned to stone and everyone is gloomy. Especially King Halbert. In order to get everything in a better mood Aaron organizes a celebration. The King wants a reenactment of Clay's heroic rescue of the Queen. He is (as usual) totally unaware of Clay's situation. In order not to disappoint him further, the Knights get a remote control for Clay's Battle suit and is thus able to “perform” as Clay. Lance is happy to exercise his acting abilities and quickly gets into the role of the uptight knight of knights. Ava is working on reinstalling Merlok 2.0 into the Fortrex with Robin. She is also preparing the Fortrex for a visit from the new Knights' Academy novices. It is a fieldtrip with Principal Brickland and Sir Griffiths with the goal of teaching the kids about these new so-called High-tech battle strategies. Not really feeling it for anything modern, it quickly turns into a regular trip back memory lane for Brickland and Sir Griffiths. This out of control excursion is an excellent moment for Jestro who is looking for an opportunity to cheer up the defeated Monstrox. Unfortunately, for Jestro, Ava is able to make Merlok 2.0 functional again, and the Novices are able to fight Jestro and his monsters off using the NEXO Power: Wedgie of Doom. It is a humiliating defeat. Apparently, this is just what the doctor ordered for Monstrox. A good laugh at someone else's expense. His evil mood is back on.

Nya digitizes Jay and uploads him into Zane's mind. Jay reviews memories of the Ninja's various motorcycles, mechs and planes in order to solve the vehicle-themed puzzle.

programme.title: The Oni And The Dragon
programme.desc: While Princess Harumi learns to adjust to the life of a Ninja, Lloyd and Jay search for answers about the Oni Masks at Mystake's Tea house, while Cole and Zane attempt to infiltrate the Sons of Garmadon biker gang. Remembering that Lloyd managed to arrest one of the gang members at Borg Tower, the Ninja decide to interrogate him to ascertain the location of the third Oni Mask. In order to get him to talk, however, Cole suggests they visit MYSTAKE'S TEA HOUSE to obtain some "truth tea." The truth-tea backfires spectacularly when Cole accidentally switches cups and drinks the tea himself. Zane is able to salvage the situation, however, and obtains a lead. He learns that the Sons of Garmadon frequent a karaoke bar called LAUGHY'S. Zane and Cole don disguises to infiltrate the bar. Cole assumes the alter ego “Rocky Dangerbuff," while Zane adopts the subtler moniker "Snake Jaguar." In order to earn the gang's trust, Cole performs a karaoke routine that is a smash success. Unfortunately, during the routine, his disguise comes loose and he is exposed as a ninja. The Sons of Garmadon attack him, and Zane (who is still in disguise) is unable to intervene. Cole is taken prisoner while Zane is invited back to the Sons of Garmadon's secret base.

programme.title: Stiix and Stones
programme.desc: The Ninja travel to the Village of Stiix to find the thief who stole the scroll of Airjitzu, but the self-serving Ronan isn't keen to sell it cheaply so the Ninja must figure out a way to make money on the docks – and when they fail to make enough cash, the Ninja decide to steal it – but have a run in with Moro and Sowlarcha. The Ninja travel to the Village of Stiix to find the thief who stole the scroll of Airjitzu, but when the self-serving Ronan isn't keen to sell it cheaply, the Ninja must figure out a way to make money on the docks. Meanwhile, reluctant to give up being Samurai X, Nya struggles to embrace being a Water Ninja, and Sensei Wu gives her a riddle to figure out. Back at Stiix, when the Ninja fail to make enough cash working the docks, the Ninja decide to steal it... but have a run in with Moro and Sowlarcha. After Moro gets away with the scroll, the Ninja are left dangling, but Ronan saves them at a price – for a piece of their share in the Tea Farm.

programme.title: Public Enemy Number One
programme.desc: The Ninja must find out as much as they can about Nadakhan before he finds the Realm Crystal to save his crew, but after the Ninja are labeled enemies by the world they used to protect, our heroes find themselves hunted by their old friend, Ronan. With the Destiny's Bounty impounded, the police hire Ronin to track down the fugitive ninja. Misako has been arrested and is confronted by Nadakhan, who reveals he has trapped Wu in the Teapot of Tyrahn. Misako accidentally reveals the location of the Realm Crystal. The ninja discover that Wu was researching djinn when he disappeared and split up to learn more about their potential new foe. Lloyd and Zane head to the Library of Domu. While there, Ronin hacks into Zane's systems and shuts him down, then captures Lloyd. Ronin uses Zane's SOS beacon to lure Kai and Nya into the desert, where they are captured. Later, Cole and Jay are defeated by Ronin as well. Meanwhile, Nadakhan has used his powers to foil the high-tech security guarding the Realm Crystal and steals it. The ninja are hauled off to Kryptarium Prison and Nadakhan is free to gather his lost crew.

programme.title: Masha's Tales
programme.desc: There was a village and a man, living in this village. In a deep forest near that village, the Bear settled in. The Bear asked the man for some tasty treats. The man gave the Bear two options of what he prefers to eat: the tops or the roots. The Bear decided to take the tops. The man grew a turnip and gave the tops to the Bear. The tops were tasteless. The Bear asked the man to try the turnip. The man agreed on the condition that the Bear will help him with the housework and keep off the flies. While chasing away the flies, the Bear accidentally hit the man on the nose. The Bear was scared and ran away into the forest, grabbing the turnip with him. Since then, people use to say “to be a fool for one's pains”.

programme.title: Masha's Tales
programme.desc: This story is about one very kind, but very poor Ali-Baba and his rich but greedy brother Kasym. Once upon a time Ali-Baba overheard the magic spell, which opens up the magic cape with numerous treasures. These treasures were stolen by the thieves and kept in this cave. One day Ali-Baba met Kasym and told him the secret spell. Kasym got inside the cape, but accidentally forgot the spell and the thieves caught him. They forced Kasym to learn the whole book of fairy tales by heart and spend one thousand days and a thousand and one nights telling these stories to them. This story teaches us to study well and avoid cheating.

programme.title: Masha's Tales
programme.desc: Once upon a time there lived a fisherman with his wife. Nearby there lived the Fox. One day the man went to a frozen pond to fish. On his way he found the Fox, who pretended to be dead, and picked her up. The Man started to fish and fell asleep over an ice-hole. The Wolf saw this and was glad as he hoped to get some fish, but the Fox told the Wolf that it's her own fisherman and if he wants to eat some fish - he should put in his own tail in an ice-hole. The Wolf's tail froze in the ice and fishes made a cute Christmas tree out of it. The Man, his Wife, the Fox, the Cat and the Mouse finally pulled the Wolf's tail out of the hole and the New Year has finally come.

Once upon a time the stepmother kicked her out of the house, but every medal has its flipside – Wee Little Havroshechka met her Prince and they lived happily ever after, and it's all because she was hard-working and clean.

To teach her a lesson, the Cat got into a bag himself and when the Fox opened it in order to eat the Rooster, the Cat jumped out of it and frightened her. The point of the story is that “if you are well off you don't seek better”.

programme.title: Ek Tha Raja Ek Thi Rani
programme.desc: When Gopal Seth learns that Gayatri has consumed an alcoholic beverage, he slaps her and tells that she has broken the trust that he had for her. Gayatri is shocked to see her father's reaction and tells that whatever happened at the Raj Mahal is a mistake and she did not do it intentionally. Gayatri's sister-in-laws add insult to injury when she claims that whether it was intentional or unintentional, the respect of their family has gone down. On the other hand, Rajamata tells Indravadhan that due to his rejection of the proposal from Sharmeela, the hopes that she had has been broken. Will Rajmata inform Indravadhan about the loan that they need to return to Gopal Seth? Keep watching to find out.Ek Tha Raja Ek Thi Rani is the story of the Royal Family of Ameerkot, which is headed by Rajmata and Rana Indravadhan Singh Deo (Siddhant Karnick). To cope with the loss of fortune faced, he marries Gayatri Seth (Drashti Dhami), the daughter of the state's biggest moneylender, Gopal Seth. This not only causes a scandal, but sets off a chain of drama events within the family and the royal servants, impacting them to change forever. At the heart of this drama is the relationship between Ranaji, who is still in love with his dead wife, and a commoner, Gayatri who now discovers that becoming a Rani does not necessarily have a fairy tale ending. It is a journey of Gayatri from being a girl with no future since she is a manglik to becoming queen of Ranaji's heart and of the people of the land!

The next day, a match arrives for Gayatri and the man who wishes to marry Gayatri is much older in age. While on the other hand, Indravadhan asks her mother not to worry about the loan that she has taken from Gopal Seth. He assures Rajmata that he would find a solution for this problem. programme.title: Yam Kisi Se Kam Nahin
programme.desc: A misfit, a God, a husband, and a breadwinner, Yamraj is a common man with a fancy job title. He tries his best to give his family what they need and manages to make a mess of everything in the bargain. Lovable and goofy, this God of Death is anything but grim. Join our hardworking but hen-pecked Yamraj, his beloved buffalo and his motely family and friends in a slice-of-life sitcom to find out how the cookie really crumbles!

programme.title: Stories By Rabindranath Tagore
programme.desc: The Characters Of Tagore'S Stories Spring Into Life Through The Cinematic Imagination Of Acclaimed Filmmaker, Anurag Basu In ‘Stories By Rabindranath Tagore'.Tagore'S Words And Basu'S Vision Have Amalgamated Into A Show That Transports You Back In Time To A World As Complicated As This One But With Far More Appeal And Beauty.

programme.title: Laal Banarasi
programme.desc: The story highlights the exploitation happening with the ‘Bunkars' in Banaras, whose craft is appreciated all around the world, but they are paid peanuts by the traders. Amidst this, blooms a love story between the two opposites - Gauri, a bunkar and Garv, a trader. The story is of Gauri who belongs to the bunkar community facing series of incidents which destroys her family and swears to bring about a change in their life and stop the exploitation by directly trading the sarees. This becomes a battle with traders creating hurdles in her life but she is unstoppable.

programme.title: Agni Vayu
programme.desc: Agni Vayu Is A Romantic Thriller That Tells The Story Of A Young, Vibrant Dr. Agni And An Ambitious Investment Banker Vayu. As Their Love Blossoms, An Unfortunate Turn Of Events Happens That Throws Them Amid Conspiracy, Misunderstanding, Swindling, And All Sorts Of Paradoxes At Every Turn. They Set Out On A Journey To Unravel The Mystery Surrounding These Events. Can They Both Solve It Together And Will They Disclose Their Feelings To Each Other During The Journey.

programme.title: Dahej Daasi
programme.desc: This story is about a 19yr old girl named Chunari, who dreams of marriage and a happy family. However, she becomes entangled in the chains of deceit, finding herself on the path to becoming a Dahej Dasi, which is a tradition still prevalent in the backward regions of Rajasthan. The show unfolds into a compelling drama of tradition versus rebellion, love versus oppression.

programme.title: Maata Ki Mahima
programme.desc: In the divine saga inspired by Bhakt Prahlad, witness the journey of Mahima, a devout disciple of Maata, as she challenges the tyranny of Indrayani, whose sins overflow in a reign of oppression. Sent into the heart of Indrayani's lineage, Mahima embodies the triumph of faith over darkness, destined to end the era of tyranny and usher in an era of righteousness.

programme.title: Janani
programme.desc: When children are young, parents care for them and give them all they need to live a good life. The circle of life, however, means that one day, it is the children's turn to care for their parents and give them a happy retired life. In the current moral fabric of society, rarely and not often it works out that way. It didn't happen that way with Savita too, as her children had no time to look after her. So she decided not to settle out and reinvent her life. She embarks on a journey to discover herself and to make her own identity as an individual. Janani tells an inspirational story of a mother who rose against all odds and became successful.

programme.title: Beti Hamari Anmol
programme.desc: In this hugely inspirational success story, Anmol, a small town girl, not only fights the societal obstacles faced by any small town girl in our country but also takes on the social stigma she has had to face for being so short heighted that she has been termed as a “dwarf”. Anmol, with her strong will power and belief in herself, fights the hate she has had to receive from her in-law's. Anmol becomes a doctor with the support of her husband, in the same hospital where her father works as a peon, to win back her dignity as well as bring a lot of pride to her and her in law's family.

programme.title: I'M LIVE
programme.desc: Joining us on this week's I'm LIVE is a singer who just wants to present good music - J_ust! J_ust made his debut in 2015 with the mini-album #DearMuse #201507_08 #PinkRibbon. Known for his heartfelt lyrics and sounds he comforts numerous listeners at the end of a tough day. Thanks to that magical power Jeong Eun-ji from Apink released a remake of his song How's your night for the soundtrack of She's My Type and his song Way Back Home was featured in the ending of JTBC Newsroom. In this episode J_ust performs How's your night Way Back Home I wanna go out Actually I like you and will be happy to console everyone's heart. Tune in to I'm LIVE and enjoy all the heartwarming songs he has to comfort you!

programme.title: I'M LIVE
programme.desc: Joining us on this week's I'm LIVE is electronic musician and producer YESEO! This artist burst into the music scene in 2016 with her first single Let It All Go. Two years later in 2018 she was nominated for Best Rookie Best Dance & Electronic Album Best Dance & Electronic Song at the 15th Korean Music Awards with her first EP Million Things. This talented musician mesmerized not only domestic listeners but those outside Korea. The UK's Noisey highlighted YESEO as one of the most ambitious young guns in Seoul and she even opened for Cherokee and Honne during their concerts in Seoul. In this episode YESEO performs Privacy HOT HAND Cigarette Light as well as Youthful Kids and Free Up from her latest EP TRY TREE! Tune in to I'm LIVE and meet this talented artist!

programme.title: Raja Rasoi Aur Andaaz Anokha
programme.desc: After the resounding success of the first two seasons, EPIC Channel presents a revamped avatar of its Raja Rasoi series. EPIC Channel's Raja Rasoi series - titled Raja Rasoi Aur Andaaz Anokha - stands true to its name. While the lore and love of Indian food remains just as passionate, the new season presents a discovery oriented show format that transforms table-top cooking into an exciting food lab. Featuring renowned chef Ranveer Brar, the show will take you to his retreat – an old-world bungalow basking in the laidback vibe of Goa and then along on a ride nostalgia and rediscovery both personal and culinary. Ranveer's passion for culinary art makes him a perfect fit as the host for the latest season of the food series. He has dedicated this experimental streak and passion for food to his mentor – Munir Ahmed, a quaint, ordinary yet passionate food enthusiast from the gullies of Lucknow who greatly influenced Brar while growing up in his hometown.

programme.title: Regiment Diaries
programme.desc: The Indian Army is an emotion – a living chronicle of events, that we have the luxury to forget because they remember. The army itself is a family of several regiments, each of which has its own history, identity, and glorious traditions. Regiment Diaries is a tale of the Indian Army unlike any told before. Told by the very men who follow the illustrious feats of their predecessors, it tells timeless tales that warm the heart, moisten the eye, and leave you in awe of the bravest children of India.

programme.title: Sharanam
programme.desc: Sharanam takes viewers on a poignant journey to some of the most revered pilgrimage sites in India to and highlights the traditions, practices, rituals and ideals that bring people to these holy places in search of something greater than themselves. Narrated by Bollywood actress Juhi Chawla, Sharanam showcases testimonies of personal incidents that are the bedrock of the belief, and follows the strong thread of faith that not only binds the pilgrims to their Gods, but also the nation with itself.

programme.title: Way Back Home
programme.desc: Rohan Thakur finds his true calling as he begins a journey to revisit his roots in Himachal Pradesh. Way Back Home is as much a travelogue of childhood, as of growing up. Get ready for a journey of a lifetime

programme.title: Indipedia
programme.desc: A light and peppy anchor driven half-hour episodic series that explores the reasons, bellefs and logic behind the customs and rituals observed as a norm In India, often so casually that most of us have never really asked why they arethe way they are.

programme.title: Umeed India
programme.desc: If you'd imagine an ace cricketer to host a television show, you can be sure it will be a sports related series. And, Umeed India makes a compelling case. For the first time, versatile cricketer Virender Sehwag will host a television show. Umeed India will showcase groundbreaking stories of diversified, intrepid athletes aiming for glory at Olympics 2020. For the 13-part series, Virender reinstates the fact that Olympic stars never ‘just' appear at the Games. Their stories start in small villages, where they train every day – with one aim in mind – bringing home that Gold. Watch Virender travel to their training bases, chronicling exciting moments in the home environment besides interviewing the athletes' families and coaching staff. The episodes feature inspiring stories of OP Karhana, Suyash Yadav, Avtar Singh and Dutee Chand along with Sakshi Malik, Vinesh Poghat among many other Olympians. Can we find the 2020 medalists for India in 2017?

programme.title: Lost Recipes
programme.desc: Lost Recipes is all about the food which is diffused into the pages of history and the rediscovery of a tradition that once was. Our host Aditya Bal is on a quest to unearth the once-popular culinary traditions through thirteen regions in India.But these recipes are no longer found in cookbooks, old or new, and seem to have evolved with time. Aditya must turn back the clock and wade through folk and lore to find the original, Lost Recipes.

programme.title: New 2023 Range Rover Sport Design Reveal Film
programme.desc: The New Range Rover Sport has made its global premiere with a dramatic world-first climb up a flooded dam spillway in Iceland. The epic ascent saw New Range Rover Sport resist the surging torrent of water flowing down the ramp of the Karahnjukar Dam – the biggest of its kind in the world – at a rate of 750 tonnes per minute. A loss of traction risked plunging down the perilous 90m drop at the base of the spillway to the valley floor below. The successful spillway ascent was screened for the first time at an exclusive launch event at Jaguar Land Rover's Advanced Product Creation Centre at Gaydon, UK. Official James Bond stunt driver Jessica Hawkins was behind the wheel as the New Range Rover Sport demonstrated its grip, traction, performance and composure, completing the latest in a series of challenges for Land Rover's luxury performance SUV. Previous feats include a record-setting hill-climb at Pikes Peak, a first recorded crossing of the ‘Empty Quarter' desert in the Arabian Peninsula and a first ascent of the 999 steps to Heaven's Gate in China, in 2018.

The Hispano Suiza Room will close the usual tour of the Peralada Castle Museum. After years of researching to gather the largest number of pieces and objects related to its history, Hispano Suiza becomes part of this important collection. The Hispano Suiza exhibition encompasses a journey through various decades: from the beginning of the 20th century, when Hispano Suiza was founded, to the present day. After passing through a luxurious hall, the public will be able to visit a recreation of the offices of Damián Mateu and Mark Birkigt, where countless business and technical ideas, emerged and took shape, turning Hispano Suiza into a point of reference, for luxury, comfort and technical solutions. In this area, the original painting 'Dame with a mink' by Ramon Casas takes pride of place: it was used as an illustration on the company's original shares.

programme.title: TechDay Digital Light
programme.desc: Safety and customer satisfaction come first at Audi. They are part and parcel of the success of the company with the four rings. In that context, light technology is steadily growing more important and creating a wider range of possibilities and perspectives, from added safety for the driver, to external communication and individualization. Systematic light digitization is making all of this possible. It is particularly visible in the new Audi A8: the forward-looking Digital Matrix LED headlights and digital OLED rear lights raise the customer experience to a whole new level: for the first time in any Audi model, light is completely digitized. The car can be individualized even further through its digital OLED rear lights. The Digital Matrix LED headlights also include three new functions: advanced traffic information, a lane light with direction indicator lights on highways, and an orientation light on country roads. These features not only demonstrate Audi's “Vorsprung durch Technik,” they also add value.

programme.title: Mercedes-Benz DRIVE PILOT Sensors S-Class
programme.desc: The exact location of a Mercedes equipped with DRIVE PILOT is determined using a high-precision positioning system that is much more powerful than conventional GPS systems. In addition to the anonymised data collected by LiDAR, camera, radar and ultrasound sensors, a digital HD map provides a three-dimensional image of the road and the surroundings with information on road geometry, route characteristics, traffic signs and special traffic events (e.g. accidents or road works). This high-precision map differs from maps for navigation devices by, among other things, its higher accuracy in the centimetre rather than metre range and its detailed junction and route model. The map data is stored in backend data centres and updated constantly. Each vehicle also stores an image of this map information on board, constantly compares it with the backend data and updates the local dataset as required. All of this enables stable and accurate positioning through a representation of the surroundings that is independent of factors such as shadows or dirty sensors.
